title: Activity log
description: Serves "Nothing is hidden.". Sign-ins and plays an operator can read.
acceptanceCriteria: Sign-ins, refused sign-ins and each playback's start and end are recorded with time, account and device, and an administrator reads them through the API.
A viewer cannot read another account's entries.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
